Not an exact upstream string.

additional_callers.purpose: Buttons only execute when not busy, through perform; no completed-clear status claim.
Undo and redo buttons operate on assembly history.
Current state is a list of assembly image entries, separate from original external image pixels.
Clear changes the complete assembly state to an empty list, not just placement or selection.

Validate/write before state change; retain prior state in undo, clear redo, prune unreachable owned cache files; current prior entries remain reachable by Undo. No indefinite/permanent source-file-retention claim.

semantic_scope: All assembly entries are removed from the active list, including placed and unplaced items. Not bitmap erasure, unplace-only, selection clearing, deleting all external files, or a statement that an operation has completed.

change validates and persists next state first. Exceptions surface through perform; no success guarantee is translated. Previous active state enters bounded in-memory Undo history, but the label does not add permanence or retention promises.
No transfer to ui_clear_image: list-removal evidence still does not establish pixel clearing. No transfer to ui_discard, which has no current direct caller.
